recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It removes the stale US Core religion extension URL from current core examples without editing disabled legacy profile source; future patient-religion packaging issues should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-12433 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and requested removing the US Realm-specific us-core-religion extension because religion had become a core extension.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioned FHIR-12433. The broader FHIR-12384 family touched source/fhir.ini in 2017, and current fhir.ini comments out the legacy us-core and cda profile inputs. A later 2018 Measure commit added active $submit-data and $collect-data examples that still used the retired us-core-religion URL.
additional_context: FHIR-11248 promoted religion to a standard/core extension. FHIR-19806 later resolved a US Core request as no-change because patient-religion already existed as a standard FHIR extension. FHIR-37517 and PA minutes updated the patient-religion binding to preferred, matching the current Extension Pack source. The Measure resource and operation examples are active build inputs, while the remaining cda.profile.xml us-core-religion reference is disabled by fhir.ini.
source_changes: source/measure/submit-data-request.json: replaced the Patient religion extension URL in the active Measure $submit-data request example with http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-religion.

source/measure/collect-data-response.json: replaced the Patient religion extension URL in the active Measure $collect-data response example with http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-religion.

related_jiras.note: Broader Published/Persuasive-with-Modification decision to remove US Realm extensions from the core specification.
